title: Promised a studio job, staying a year with Basie, then walking away
summary: Edison went back to Basie for a year instead of the promised Hollywood Palace job, then left the bus in San Francisco.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Joe and I, we terminated our association. And then I came back out here in California in 1960 -- well, I was promised a studio job at ABC with Mitchell Ayres, the Hollywood Palace show. It went on every week. I was promised that job by Johnny Fresco, the contractor, and I told Basie I had to go back to assume, you know, my work out here, you know, and I had gotten married and my daughter was -- my wife was pregnant at the time and I told him I couldn't stay too long because I had a job to go to, which was a studio job. So he just kept saying, "Well, a couple more weeks, couple more weeks."
So I ended up staying there a year. Then --
This was when you -- yeah, this is when you first went to Europe.

And so I finally -- San Francisco, when we came back from Europe, we just did one-nighters, and I just -- I hated to leave, so I just took my uniform, put it in the bus and split. I didn't even want to say goodbye or anything, you know. Then I came back to California and I assumed my studio work out here. I did the Hollywood Palace show for three years with Mitchell Ayresand the experience I got there playing was just absolutely fantastic.
